site.description: Technology, Design, and Entrepreneurship. A 5-year private college nested in the mountains of Kamiyama, Tokushima.

disclaimer: This site is an unofficial demo and is NOT the official website of Kamiyama Marugoto College of Technology.

hero.title:
Five years to learn
from mountains and forests.
hero.lead:
Technology, Design, Entrepreneurship.
We nurture the power to move society forward, surrounded by the nature of Kamiyama.

about.title: A college that raises makers who start things
about.lead: Opened in 2023 in Kamiyama, Tokushima — a 5-year private college of technology with on-campus housing for all students.

points.title: Opened in April 2023
points.body: The first new KOSEN founded in 55 years, born in Kamiyama, Tokushima.

points.title: 5-year integrated, full residential
points.body: From age 15, students live and learn together as a community for five years.

points.title: Aiming for fully subsidized tuition
points.body: Through a strong scholarship program, we aim to enable any student to attend.

points.title: Rooted in nature & community
points.body: Hands-on learning that emerges from the mountains, rivers, and people of Kamiyama.

about.note: * Summary content based on publicly available information, for demo purposes.

curriculum.title: Three pillars to sharpen the power to make
curriculum.lead: Technology, Design, and Entrepreneurship — woven together to span ideation, implementation, and real-world impact.

items.title: Technology
items.body: Programming, AI, electronics. Build working things with your own hands.

items.title: Design
items.body: Observation and editing — designing the space between people and society.

items.title: Entrepreneurship
items.body: Turn ideas into ventures, from prototyping to financial planning.

campus.title: A campus in the mountains
campus.lead: Forests, rice terraces, rivers — nature itself becomes the textbook.
